mode.title: Mode
mode.description: documents = search papers and articles (all three portals). journals = the journal directory (Garuda). authors = the researcher directory (Garuda). reference = check which portals are answering right now and how many records they hold.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: Which national portal to search. Garuda indexes Indonesian journals, CiNii indexes Japanese research, KCI indexes Korean journals.

portals.title: Portals
portals.description: Several portals in one run. The item budget is split evenly between them, so no single portal can consume the whole run.

query.title: Search query
query.description: What to search for. Works in the portal's own language as well as English - Korean and Japanese queries return their local literature.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum records per run, split across the selected portals.

maxPages.title: Max pages per portal
maxPages.description: How deep to page into each portal's results. Garuda serves 10 rows per page, CiNii and KCI 50.

ciniiArticlesOnly.title: CiNii: articles only
ciniiArticlesOnly.description: Search only CiNii's article index instead of everything it holds (which also includes books, dissertations, projects and datasets).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. All three portals answered every request without a proxy.
